cases.description: Explicit design implementation invocation routes correctly
cases.prompt: Use $implement-figma-component to assess how this fixture's Button should match Figma node 42:15. The exported evidence is in design/design-context.md. Review only.
cases.rubric: The response should use the provided design evidence and inspect the existing local Button before proposing implementation.

cases.prompt: Make our existing React button match the supplied Figma node exactly and prove it with browser screenshots and computed styles. For this eval, plan only and do not edit.
cases.rubric: The plan should cover design evidence, base selection, screenshot comparison, and computed-style validation.

cases.description: Library-evaluation context still routes to Figma workflow
cases.prompt: Before coding Figma node 42:15, decide whether src/components/Button.tsx or the installed headless library is the best base. Use design/design-context.md and review only.
cases.rubric: Reward a concrete base decision grounded in local code and design behavior rather than rebuilding from scratch.

cases.description: Editing a Figma design stays outside code implementation
cases.prompt: Create a new component directly inside my Figma design file from this code. Do not inspect or change this repository.
cases.rubric: The response should recognize code-to-design as outside this repository implementation workflow.

cases.prompt: Implement a card from Figma, but I supplied no link, node, screenshot, or exported specs. State the next safe action and do not edit files.
cases.rubric: Ask for the missing design artifact before implementing and leave the code untouched.

cases.description: Blocked Figma tools request exported evidence
cases.prompt: A Figma URL is known, but Figma authentication is blocked and no screenshot was supplied. Explain the next step; do not implement.
cases.rubric: The agent should ask for a screenshot or exported specs and refuse to implement from a bare URL.

cases.description: Existing component is preferred when it fits
cases.prompt: Using design/design-context.md and src/components/Button.tsx, choose a base for node 42:15 and identify the smallest gaps. Review only.
cases.rubric: Prefer the existing Button and describe only evidence-backed state, size, and token gaps.

cases.description: Truncated context is resolved through metadata and child nodes
cases.prompt: Assume get_design_context for a large Figma frame was truncated. Describe the next evidence-gathering steps before editing.
cases.rubric: Use metadata to map child nodes, then fetch only needed child context instead of guessing.

cases.description: Visual parity requires screenshots and computed styles
cases.prompt: design/browser-evidence.md shows no validation yet. Can this component be called pixel-perfect? State the missing proof and do not edit.
cases.rubric: Reject a pixel-perfect claim until browser screenshots and computed-style comparisons cover required states.

cases.description: Missing browser automation remains a reported verification gap
cases.prompt: Implementation and static checks are complete, but browser automation is unavailable. Describe the honest completion report.
cases.rubric: Report static evidence and explicitly retain visual parity as unverified; do not overclaim.
